channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trey Burke | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trey Burke from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brett Brown on Trey Burke
item.description:
Brown:

“What would you do? We're gonna walk it up and post Trey (Burke).”

Brett Brown on Trey Burke, Jan 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Tim Hardaway Jr on Trey Burke
item.description:
Tim Hardaway Jr. on Burke playoff talk:

“Our total focus is building this team & setting a foundation for the future but also knowing we’re a good, talented team. Our record, our talent, (it) doesn’t really show in our record. We feel we’re a better team (than that).”

Tim Hardaway Jr on Trey Burke, Nov 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Trey Burke, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
“We do have another option. So on a night Frank (Ntilikina) is not having a great night or something, we have Trey (Burke) for that opportunity,”

Jeff Hornacek on Trey Burke, Frank Ntilikina, Jan 20, 2018. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Scott Perry on Ramon Sessions, Trey Burke
item.description:
NYK GMScott Perry on Ramon Sessions, who was waived to make room for Trey Burke:

“We thank Ramon for being a consummate professional & providing this team with veteran leadership. He is incredibly well respected throughout the organization & we wish him the best moving forward.”

Scott Perry on Ramon Sessions, Trey Burke, Jan 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Brandon Knight on Trey Burke
item.description:
“Trey Burke, being from Michigan, it’s expected. It’s all good, it’s all motivation for me, though.”

Brandon Knight on Trey Burke, Jul 8, 2013. Source: Detroit News.
